name: Charlie Health
desc:
Care Experience Specialist | $45K to $55K/yr (about $21.63 to $26.44/hr) | Mostly Inbound Patient Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: Charlie Health
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Charlie Health provides virtual mental health, substance use, and eating disorder treatment, mostly for teens and young adults. In this role, you're the main point of contact for clients and their families once they've started treatment. You'll answer inbound calls, emails, and texts and solve their concerns or requests. You'll connect clients with other Charlie Health teams like Admissions, Billing, and Clinical, notice when someone starts missing sessions and reach out to help, and schedule or reschedule appointments. When treatment ends, you'll share aftercare options, like outpatient therapists, and help families book those appointments. Everything gets documented, and you'll be measured on things like answer rate, call volume, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and emotional intelligence
- Calm, caring communication with families
- Multitasking in a fast-paced setting
- Problem solving and follow-through
- Adapting to change
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: At least 2 years in a customer or patient support role, 1 to 2 years using Salesforce or a similar CRM, 1 to 2 years using contact center technology, and experience working with young adults and teens
Preferred Experience: Working with young adults and teens in a healthcare setting

Required Skills:
- Strong multitasking in a fast-paced environment
- High emotional intelligence
- Knowledge of HIPAA
- Comfortable with Slack, Google tools, Microsoft Office, Zoom, and electronic medical records
- Native or bilingual English
- Authorized to work in the United States

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 2+ years of call center or customer support using a CRM
- Has worked with teens or young adults, like in coaching, childcare, or a youth-focused job
- Cares about mental health and wants meaningful work
- Stays calm and kind with stressed families

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 2 years of customer or patient support experience
- Has never used a CRM or call center software
- Would find conversations about mental health or substance use too heavy
- Lives in one of the excluded states listed in Other Information
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process. Several state background checks are required, including a fingerprint check for Florida, and Charlie Health pays for them. Real Charlie Health emails only come from @charliehealth.com, and they never ask for fees or banking info before onboarding.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Patient support
- Care coordination
- Salesforce or CRM
- Contact center
- Appointment scheduling
- Aftercare coordination
- HIPAA
- Youth and young adult support
- Behavioral health
- Customer satisfaction

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer or patient support experience and the CRM you used.
- Tell us about your experience working with teens or young adults.
- A client has missed their last two sessions. How would you reach out?
- Tell us about a time you helped a very upset customer or family member. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you juggled many requests at once. How did you prioritize, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $45,000 to $55,000 a year, about $21.63 to $26.44/hr. Based on location and experience, and the role may include incentives or bonuses. The posting says benefits are for full-time exempt employees, which usually means salaried with no overtime pay, so confirm in the screen.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Comprehensive benefits for full-time employees. Details are on Charlie Health's careers page.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case. Several state background checks are required to work with clients, including a fingerprint check for Florida, paid for by Charlie Health.
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is meaningful, mission-driven work supporting young people in mental health treatment, with strong pay. It's mostly inbound with no sales. Not open to candidates in Alaska, Maine, Washington DC, New Jersey, California, New York, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Colorado, Washington State, Oregon, or Minnesota. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Care Experience Specialist → Senior Care Experience Specialist → Care Experience Team Lead → Care Coordination Manager. This role builds behavioral health care coordination, CRM, and patient support skills.
